description: Full-width responsive container web part supporting tabs, accordions, and custom cards/embeds for SharePoint Online.
architecture: SPFx v1.22+ Heft Toolchain with React and Fluent UI / Glassmorphism Design System

modules.name: FullWidthContainerWebPart
modules.role: Entrypoint SPFx WebPart class managing lifecycle, theme variants, property pane, and rendering React root.

modules.name: FullWidthContainer
modules.role: Root React container component handling state, layout switching (Tabs/Accordion), filtering, and search.

modules.name: TabsContainer
modules.role: Pill & underline tabbed navigation view with micro-animations and active indicators.

modules.name: AccordionContainer
modules.role: Collapsible accordion panels with smooth height transitions and multi/single expand modes.

modules.name: BlockRenderer
modules.role: Renders child content items (Rich Cards, Embeds/iFrames, Key Metrics in GBP £, Quick Links).

modules.name: ContainerModels
modules.role: Type definitions for panels, tabs, items, layout configuration, and theme tokens.

modules.name: Styles
modules.role: SCSS module delivering Antigravity Glassmorphism, backdrop filters, responsive grids, and dark/light tokens.
